## Type of contribution

- [ ] New writing rule for `rules/writing-rules.md`
- [ ] Sanitized before/after example
- [ ] Agent prompt improvement

## The contribution

**For a writing rule:**
Paste the rule in this format:
```
- No "[phrase]" — [one line reason why it kills credibility with recruiters]
```

**For a before/after example:**
Paste the before and after versions. Confirm all real names, companies, titles, locations, and contact info have been replaced with placeholders.

**For a prompt improvement:**
What changed, why it produces better output, and at least one before/after example (sanitized).

## Where does this come from

Did you learn this from a real job search? A recruiter? A hiring manager? Brief context helps others trust the rule.

## Confirmation

- [ ] I've removed all real names, companies, and personal information from any examples
- [ ] This is based on real experience, not theory
